CREATE TABLE `t_tenant_company_relation` (
  `child_company_id` int NOT NULL,
  `parent_company_id` int NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`child_company_id`),
  KEY `idx_tenant_company_parent` (`parent_company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_child_company` FOREIGN KEY (`child_company_id`) REFERENCES `m_company` (`company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_parent_company` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_company_id`) REFERENCES `m_company` (`company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_tenant_company_relation` CHECK (((`child_company_id` <> `parent_company_id`) and (`child_company_id` > 0) and (`parent_company_id` > 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `t_tenant_company_grant` (
  `grant_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `program_id` int NOT NULL,
  `root_company_id` int NOT NULL,
  `include_descendants` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `role_key` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `permissions` json NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `version` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_at` timestamp(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  PRIMARY KEY (`grant_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_tenant_company_grant` (`user_id`,`program_id`,`root_company_id`),
  KEY `idx_tenant_grant_program` (`program_id`),
  KEY `idx_tenant_grant_root` (`root_company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_grant_company` FOREIGN KEY (`root_company_id`) REFERENCES `m_company` (`company_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_grant_program` FOREIGN KEY (`program_id`) REFERENCES `m_company_program_list` (`program_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_tenant_grant_user` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `user` (`user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_tenant_grant_permissions` CHECK ((json_type(`permissions`) = _utf8mb4'ARRAY'))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
